general.description: Manage host agents for MuckiSafe backups

host.emptyState: No agents have been provisioned yet.
host.rotateConfirmText: A new secret will be issued for "{name}". The current secret stops working immediately until the agent on the host receives the new one.
host.revokeConfirmText: "{name}" will be revoked permanently and can no longer authenticate. A revocation cannot be undone.

provision.title: Provision agent
provision.description: Creates a new agent and issues its key ID and secret. The secret is shown exactly once.

secret.onceWarning: The secret is shown only now and cannot be retrieved later. Store it securely before closing this dialog.
secret.keyIdHelp: Value for server.keyId in the agent configuration.
secret.secretHelp: Content of the file configured as server.secretFile (readable by root only).
secret.confirmStored: I have stored the secret securely.

errors.keyring_unavailable: The encryption keyring for agent secrets is missing or invalid (MUWA_AGENT_ENCRYPTION_KEYRING). Check the server configuration.
errors.operation_failed: The operation failed. See the log for details.
errors.technical_name_taken: The technical name is already taken.
errors.timeout_out_of_range: The phase budget is outside the allowed range.
errors.facility_repository_not_found: The Facility repository does not exist.
errors.legacy_hook_conflict: Legacy hooks are still active on the Facility repository.
errors.agent_unavailable: The target agent is revoked, disabled or does not exist.
errors.capability_missing: The target agent lacks a capability the action requires.
errors.action_unavailable: The action is disabled or does not exist.

action.emptyState: No actions have been created yet.
action.technicalNameHelp: Unique ID made of lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (max. 64 characters). Cannot be changed after creation.
action.idempotencyClassHelp: safe: may run again after a lease expires. non_retryable: never retried automatically; an interruption ends as unknown.

retryPolicies.safe: Up to 3 attempts on lease expiry

action.maxTimeoutSecondsHelp: Upper bound for the phase budget of a repository hook using this action (45 to 1800 seconds).
action.definitionHint: The server strictly validates the definition against action DSL v1 and stores it canonically. Capabilities and hash are derived from it. Parameters are not part of v1.

fieldErrors.technicalName: Invalid or already taken. Allowed: a-z, 0-9, - and _, starting with a letter.
fieldErrors.label: Please enter a label of at most 255 characters.
fieldErrors.defaultTimeoutSeconds: Must be between 45 seconds and the maximum timeout.

hook.emptyState: No repository hooks have been assigned yet.
hook.phaseHelp: There is exactly one hook per repository and phase. Repository and phase are fixed once the hook exists.
hook.timeoutSecondsHelp: Allowed: {min} to {max} seconds (upper bound from the phase and the action's maximum timeout).
hook.failOnErrorHelp: If the action fails, the backup counts as failed. Without this option the error is only logged.
hook.legacyConflictTitle: Legacy hooks active on the Facility repository
hook.legacyConflictText: This repository still runs its own commands ({fields}). Set them to "No execution" in the Facility module before assigning agent hooks.
hook.capabilityMismatchText: The agent does not report these capabilities of the action: {capabilities}. The server rejects the assignment until the agent reports them.
hook.deleteConfirmText: The hook for "{repository}" in phase {phase} will be deleted. Jobs already created are kept.

run.emptyState: There are no backup runs with agent hooks yet.
run.noJobs: No jobs were created for this run.

job.outputRequiresExecutor: The error output (stdout/stderr) is visible with the "Executor" role only.

rollback.description: The rollback switches agent execution off globally: Facility backups then run without agent hooks, no new agent runs or jobs are created and agents no longer claim jobs. The rollback can be reversed.
rollback.unknownHint: Jobs in state "Unknown" do not block hook removal but are never repeated automatically. Assess them manually: check on the respective host whether the action was executed.
rollback.gateInactive: The rollback is not active. Agent hooks run normally.
rollback.gateNotReady: Jobs are still open (queued, claimed, running or cancel requested). Only remove the hooks once all open jobs have finished.
rollback.gateReady: No open jobs left: the agent hooks can now be removed as described in the runbook.
rollback.runbookHint: The procedure, checks and way back are described in the plugin runbook docs/rollout-runbook.md.
rollback.startConfirmText: Agent execution is switched off globally. From now on Facility backups continue without agent hooks; no new agent runs or jobs are created and agents no longer claim jobs. Starting again cancels jobs created in the meantime.
rollback.startConfirmJobs: Open jobs are cancelled: queued and claimed jobs end as timed out (rollback), running jobs receive a cancel request.
rollback.startConfirmRunning: If a backup is running right now, its post and finally hooks are skipped. Afterwards check the state of the affected hosts (e.g. restart stopped services).
rollback.startSuccess: The rollback is active, open jobs were cancelled.
rollback.stopConfirmText: Agent execution is switched on again. From the next backup on, configured agent hooks create jobs again and agents execute them. Cancelled jobs are not repeated.

muwa_agent.label: Mucki Agent
muwa_agent.provisioner: Provision agents, rotate secrets and revoke agents
muwa_agent.executor: Read error output (stdout/stderr) of failed jobs
muwa_agent.rollback: Start and stop the controlled rollback (switch agent execution off globally, cancel open jobs)
